currentUnitEconomics.boothTypicalNetPerSaleJPY: depends on current product price and BOOTH fee; verify official fee each run
currentUnitEconomics.noteTypicalNetBeforeWithdrawalJPY: depends on price and payment method; verify current note fees when pricing

externalBenchmarks.genericEcommerceConversionRate: broad ecommerce benchmarks are context only and should not be treated as BOOTH/note-specific conversion rates
externalBenchmarks.seoLag: Google states some search effects appear in days but site-level effects can take several months
externalBenchmarks.noteMarket: practical know-how pricing should follow current demand, competition, conversion and value rather than a fixed low-price rule

first12MonthsNetJPY.breakout: above 1000000 is possible but should not be used as the planning expectation

revenueModel.formula: traffic x conversion rate x average order value x repeat purchase frequency
revenueModel.priorityRule: choose the intervention with the highest expected sales impact multiplied by execution confidence and divided by cost
revenueModel.note: SKU count, PV, margin and production volume are supporting metrics, not the objective. The top-level objective is total sales growth.

trafficMath.note: Use observed high-intent paid-product visits and actual conversion once analytics exist; do not infer performance from total free-tool pageviews.

interventionGates.minimumSignal: at least 3 observed paid transactions across active channels
ifBelow: audit titles, previews, search intent, buyer problem and acquisition funnels
build or improve canonical high-intent acquisition funnels
continue creating additional products only where independent demand evidence and differentiation remain strong
raise value and pricing where low AOV is the bottleneck

interventionGates.minimumSignal: at least 5000 JPY monthly net run-rate or equivalent repeated purchase signal
ifBelow: concentrate on the strongest demand categories
test a materially different acquisition channel, buyer segment or offer structure
evaluate low-friction external distribution or affiliate opportunities
improve bundles, cross-sells and price ladders where appropriate

interventionGates.minimumSignal: at least 10000 JPY monthly net run-rate
ifBelow: treat organic BOOTH/note-only acquisition as insufficient
test organization-license positioning for suitable practical tools
evaluate higher-value productized offers that remain low-touch
retire or de-prioritize weak categories while continuing expansion in stronger ones

interventionGates.minimumSignal: at least 20000 JPY monthly net run-rate
ifBelow: pivot toward proven search demand and higher willingness-to-pay problems
stop weak categories rather than maintaining them
consider cross-platform English localization only for products with credible demand
do not compensate for weak economics by creating low-value clones

productionPolicy.rule: No fixed weekly, daily or per-run production maximum. Create as many artifacts as can meet quality, demand, originality, policy and security standards.
qualityGuardrails: no plaintext paid assets in public repositories
verify current market and platform rules before pricing or distribution decisions
if a candidate is weak, switch to a stronger candidate or materially improve an existing funnel instead of ending without a deliverable
